yamlCheck.dateAnchor: DF25 gives no absolute calendar date. The May 13–23 span comes from YAML.
yamlCheck.explanation: First camp, second camp, Havdar camp, the next travel day, and the house overnight establish five boundaries before the final journey. Inclusive sixth-day arrival supplies five more, fitting ten; literal six days after departure supplies six, yielding eleven. Opening historical recaps do not extend the played interval.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: DF25 gives two counts for the return to Karawa. On the same approach in DF26 (u0005–u0009), the DM says “it’s May 23” and places departure from the stone house about five days earlier. This supports the inclusive sixth-day reading.

Six full elapsed days after May 18 departure, conditional on YAML opening date.
